Bhaiya's Teachings — Knowledge Base (Session 21)
Topic: Aura Pr otection — The Physical Body and the Astral Body

Sour ce: A short Ashaeiynn Foundation training video (video transcript, ~10.5 min) — a dir ect instructional monologue rather than a live satsang Q&A. Explicitly framed as a dir ect continuation of the earlier training module on the "Thr ee Conditions of Mantra" (Session 14), now unpacking Condition One (a clean aura) in depth — specifically how the physical and astral bodies relate to each other , and why aura pr otection is a genuine pr erequisite befor e mantra shakti can pr operly settle. Purpose: Chatbot knowledge — English version. Note on conversational content: this is a short, dir ect training monologue with no sangat back-and-forth — ther e is no separate curated conversational supplement for this session (see closing note).
1. WHY THIS TOPIC MATTERS

This session dir ectly continues Session 14's teaching on the thr ee prerequisite conditions of mantra , now unpacking the first of those conditions — a clean aura, covering both the physical body and the astral body — step by step. This teaching explains why aura pr otection is a genuine necessity , not an incidental nicety .
2. PHYSICAL BODY AND ASTRAL BODY — TWO SIDES OF THE SAME COIN

The physical body and the astral (sukshma) body ar e described as two sides of a single coin. If repeated, sustained work happens on the physical body , it will eventually show up on the astral body — and equally , if sustained work happens on the astral body , it will eventually show up in the physical body . Neither operates in true isolation fr om the other . Illustrative example: saints and sadhus often have visibly weak, thin physical bodies, yet their astral body is so powerful that they can accomplish almost anything thr ough it — their sankalp shakti (willpower) is described as tremendous, with the underlying ener gy for physical-world action actually being supplied by their astral body . The reverse pattern also occurs: some people appear physically very str ong, yet give up quickly or can't get things accomplished — in this case, the physical world/body is strong, but the astral body is not; it works both ways ("vice versa"), and this distinction is worth understanding car efully .
3. WHY AURA PROTECTION OF THE PHYSICAL BODY MATTERS

Until the physical body's aura is genuinely pr otected, a mantra will not settle ("baithna") in a practitioner's aura at all — this is presented as a hard prerequisite, not an optional refinement. Practical steps for physical-body aura pr otection: bathing r egularly , staying clean and tidy , bathing with Gangajal, performing yachaman (a purification rinse/prayer), or being awakened thr ough mantra by someone alr eady established in mantra practice. A mor e specific Ashaeiynn method for this is reserved for later , mor e detailed training videos. Bhaiya notes he won't dwell long on physical-body aura car e specifically , since anyone alr eady engaged with this material likely alr eady handles basic physical cleanliness well — the guidance given is simply: stay clean, and use Gangajal/achaman as needed.
4. HOW THE ASTRAL BODY IS CLEANSED

The astral body can be cleansed thr ough many differ ent methods. Water is one significant channel: regular bathing with physical water also has a cleansing ef fect on the astral body's aura, not just the physical body . Other methods observed acr oss differ ent practices: healing the astral body thr ough gemstones/objects, wearing rings, wearing a Rudraksha mala, working thr ough mantra practice, r eceiving a Guru's grace, or visiting temples. Astral-body cleansing can genuinely happen through any of these various channels. The specific method Ashaeiynn will teach going forward is mantra-based — using specific mantras taught in later videos, through which a practitioner can invoke (aahvaan) the relevant shaktis directly , and those shaktis will then clean the practitioner's aura once properly invoked and prayed to.
5. WHY THE ASTRAL BODY MATTERS SO MUCH — ITS CAPABILITIES EXCEED THE PHYSICAL BODY'S

The astral body is described as a genuinely deep concept, with capabilities far exceeding what the physical body alone can achieve. Illustrative example: the physical body has hard limits — the world's highest recorded deadlift is around 390 kg, and no human has exceeded that; similarly , there are hard ceilings on how fast a person can run or how much physical endurance a person can sustain. The astral body helps fulfill exactly these physical limitations — where the physical body reaches its ceiling, a welldeveloped astral body can extend a practitioner's genuine capability well beyond it.
6. A HISTORICAL ILLUSTRATION — HANUMAN JI MAHARAJ'S PHYSICAL-ASTRAL CONNECTION IN TRETA YUGA

In Treta Yuga, the physical body and astral body wer e far mor e tightly connected/attached than they ar e today — whatever occurred in a person's astral body would manifest directly and immediately in their physical body , with very little separation between the two. This is offer ed as the explanation for how Hanuman Ji Maharaj could gr ow larger or smaller in his physical form — after receiving his blessings (aashirwad) and boons (vardan) at the astral level, whatever he did astrally would directly manifest in his physical body , since the two were so closely linked at that time.
7. HOW THE DISTANCE BETWEEN PHYSICAL AND ASTRAL BODY HAS GROWN OVER THE YUGAS

As the ages pr ogr essed — from Satya Yuga thr ough Treta Yuga into Dwapar Yuga and now Kali Yuga — the astralphysical connection gradually weakened, and the distance between the two bodies kept gr owing. Satya and Treta Yuga are described as having this connection very close together; Dwapar Yuga saw a further gap open up; Kali Yuga has the largest gap of all. As a dir ect consequence, astral activities/miracles (chamatkar) became pr ogr essively less fr equent acr oss the yugas — though they never disappear ed entirely , just diminished.
8. HOW TO RECONNECT THE PHYSICAL AND ASTRAL BODY — AND WHY CARE IS NEEDED

Reconnecting the physical and astral body , and r eactivating their combined power , can genuinely be done thr ough dhyana (meditation) — this teaching confirms meditation is a real and valid path toward this reconnection. However , HOW MUCH, WHEN, and HOW to meditate matters a gr eat deal, and must be learned pr operly first. Jumping dir ectly into unsupervised meditation risks establishing unwanted communication with whatever entity may alr eady be pr esent ar ound or behind a practitioner , which can cr eate r eal pr oblems rather than genuine pr ogr ess. This is exactly why this session focuses first on astral body pr otection (via mantra-based methods, to be taught in mor e detail in upcoming videos) befor e any teaching on meditation itself is intr oduced — protection has to come before deeper astral engagement, not the other way around.
9. WHAT'S COMING NEXT

Future training videos will cover , in mor e depth: exactly how to pr operly perform aura pr otection, why aura pr otection specifically matters, and why saints and sadhus consistently choose to sit and practice sadhna in ONE fixed location, rather than moving ar ound to differ ent places for their practice.
QUICK RULES SUMMARY

1. The physical body and astral body are two sides of one coin — sustained work on either one eventually shows up in the other; some people are physically weak but astrally powerful (saints/sadhus), and vice versa. 2. Mantra shakti will not settle in a practitioner's aura until the physical body's aura is genuinely protected first — this is a hard prerequisite. 3. Physical-body aura protection: regular bathing, cleanliness, Gangajal, yachaman (purification prayer), or mantra-based awakening by an established practitioner; Ashaeiynn's own specific method is taught in later , more advanced sessions. 4. The astral body can be cleansed through many valid channels — water/bathing, gemstones, rings, Rudraksha mala, mantra practice, Guru's grace, or temple visits; Ashaeiynn's own method going forward is specifically mantra-based. 5. The astral body's capabilities genuinely exceed the physical body's hard limits (e.g., maximum deadlift, maximum running speed) — a developed astral body helps a practitioner extend well beyond ordinary physical ceilings. 6. In Treta Yuga, the physical and astral body were tightly connected, so astral changes (as with Hanuman Ji Maharaj's sizeshifting) manifested directly and immediately in the physical body . 7. The gap between physical and astral body has steadily widened across the yugas (Satya/T reta close, Dwapar wider , Kali Yuga widest), causing astral miracles to become progressively less frequent, though never fully disappearing. 8. Meditation (dhyana) is a genuine way to reconnect and reactivate the physical-astral bond, but how much, when, and how to meditate must be learned properly first — unsupervised meditation risks unwanted communication with entities already present around a practitioner . 9. This is why astral body protection (via mantra) must be taught and established before meditation itself — protection comes first, deeper astral engagement comes after . 10. Future sessions will cover proper aura protection methods in depth, and why saints and sadhus practice sadhna consistently in one fixed location rather than moving around.

Part II — Q&A Pairs (English)
Bhaiya's Teachings — Q&A Pairs (Session 21, English)
Aura Pr otection — The Physical Body and the Astral Body
User-style questions with answers gr ounded in this Ashaeiynn Foundation training module. Gr eeting style: "Jai Siya Ram."

Q1. How exactly ar e my physical body and my astral (sukshma) body r elated to each other? A: Jai Siya Ram! They're described as two sides of one coin — sustained, repeated work on either one will eventually show up on the other . Saints and sadhus are a clear example: physically thin and weak, yet capable of extraordinary things through a powerful astral body and tremendous sankalp shakti (willpower). The reverse also happens — someone physically strong-looking can still give up easily or struggle to get things done, meaning their astral body isn't as developed as their physical one. It works both ways.

Q2. Why do I need to bother with "aura pr otection" at all befor e starting mantra practice? A: Because mantra shakti simply will not settle in your aura until your physical body's aura is genuinely protected first. This is presented as a hard prerequisite in this teaching, not an optional nicety — skipping this step means the mantra has nowhere stable to "sit."

Q3. What ar e the actual practical steps for protecting my physical body's aura? A: Bathing regularly , staying clean and tidy , bathing with Gangajal, performing yachaman (a purification rinse/prayer), or being awakened through mantra by someone already established in mantra practice. Ashaeiynn's own more specific method for this is reserved for later , more advanced training sessions — for now , basic cleanliness and Gangajal/achaman are suf ficient.

Q4. How is the astral body actually cleansed, as opposed to the physical body? A: Through many dif ferent valid channels: water/regular bathing (which also cleanses the astral aura, not just the physical one), gemstones or objects, rings, a Rudraksha mala, mantra practice, a Guru's grace, or temple visits. The specific method Ashaeiynn will teach going forward is mantra-based — invoking the relevant shaktis through a specific mantra, who then clean the practitioner's aura once properly invoked and prayed to.

Q5. Is the astral body actually mor e capable than my physical body , or just "spiritual" in a vague sense? A: It's described as genuinely , concretely more capable. The physical body has hard limits — for example, the world's highest recorded deadlift is around 390 kg, and no human has exceeded that; there are similar hard ceilings on running speed and physical endurance. A well-developed astral body helps a practitioner fulfill and extend beyond exactly these physical limitations.

Q6. How could Hanuman Ji Maharaj gr ow larger or smaller in his physical body? A: This teaching explains it through the physical-astral connection specific to Treta Yuga: at that time, the physical and astral bodies were far more tightly connected than they are today , so whatever happened astrally manifested directly and immediately in the physical body . After Hanuman Ji Maharaj received his blessings and boons at the astral level, his astral actions translated straight into visible physical changes, including his size-shifting.

Q7. Why don't we see miracles like that as often today? A: Because the connection between the physical and astral body has steadily weakened across the yugas — Satya and Treta Yuga had this connection very tightly linked, Dwapar Yuga saw a further gap open, and Kali Yuga (our current age) has the widest gap of all. As a direct result, astral miracles became progressively less frequent over time, though they never fully disappeared.

Q8. Can I just start meditating to r econnect my physical and astral body myself? A: Meditation (dhyana) is confirmed as a genuine, valid way to reconnect and reactivate this bond — but how much, when, and how to meditate matters a great deal, and needs to be learned properly first. Jumping directly into unsupervised meditation risks establishing unwanted communication with whatever entity may already be present around or behind you, which can create real problems rather than genuine progress.

Q9. If meditation is risky without pr eparation, what should I focus on first instead? A: Astral body protection, through mantrabased methods, comes first — this is exactly why this session focuses on protection before introducing meditation itself. Protection has to be established before deeper astral engagement is safe, not the other way around.

Q10. What's coming in futur e training sessions on this topic? A: More depth on exactly how to properly perform aura protection, why it matters so specifically , and why saints and sadhus consistently choose to sit and do their sadhna in ONE fixed location rather than moving between dif ferent places for their practice.
Bot Response Guidelines (Session 21 additions)

When a user asks why mantra jaap "isn't working" or feels inef fective, mention aura protection as a foundational prerequisite (consistent with Session 14) — a mantra needs a protected aura to settle into, both physically and astrally . Never encourage a user to jump straight into unsupervised or intensive meditation practice — this session explicitly warns that improper meditation risks unwanted communication with entities already present around a practitioner . Suggest proper guidance/mentorship first. When explaining the physical-vs-astral body relationship, use the "two sides of one coin" framing and the saints/sadhus example (physically weak, astrally powerful) to make the concept concrete. If a user asks about historical miracles (e.g., Hanuman Ji Maharaj's size-shifting), use the Treta-Yuga tight physical-astral connection explanation rather than treating it as unexplained magic. Do not overstate what Ashaeiynn has taught so far on the specific mantra-based aura protection method — this session explicitly defers the detailed method to later videos; acknowledge that more specific techniques come later rather than inventing details.
